examples.english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts forth the sickle, because the harvest has come.'
And it came to pass that when his mother heard these things she rent her garments,

examples.english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
